messages:
Alyssa: PagerDuty triggered for high tail latency on /v1/generate p99>1.2s across eu-west. Paging now.
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — p99 latency breach detected for inference-service (route: /v1/generate). Threshold 1.2s, current p99 1.45s. Alert group: latency-slo-eu. PagerDuty incident: PD12345
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> Incident PD12345. Notified: Alyssa, Mike, oncall
Mike: acked PD12345 :white_check_mark: Looking at metrics, dashboard shows spike starting 02:03 UTC. Rolling avg throughput +40% vs baseline.
Samir: I'm on infra. Checking autoscaler logs.
Devon: I see KV cache evictions correlate with the spike — cache hit drops from 87% -> 28% around same time.
Alyssa: customer impact? Any 500s or errors?
Katie: No increase in 5xx, just high tail latency and some timeouts on client retries. Affected customers: some high-throughput integrations in eu-west only.
Mike: Trying a soft mitigation: pin route to warm pool in eu-west-1 by switching routing policy to dedicated pool.
Samir: autoscaler didn't scale fast enough — max_nodes reached on the cluster due to quota.
Devon: workaround: enable regional fallthrough to eu-north standby nodes (lower perf but capacity available). I'll open the routing override.
Alyssa: Do it. Also reduce batch size on the serving runtime to reduce tail latency. Samir can you flip per-deployment env BATCH_SIZE=8?
Samir: Pushing patch now. Command:
```
kubectl set env deployment/inference-runtime BATCH_SIZE=8 -n inference-eu-west
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime -n inference-eu-west
```
Samir: deployed, rollout started.
deploy-bot: Rollout started for deployment/inference-runtime in inference-eu-west by Samir (revision v2026.3.14-1)
Mike: Routing override applied: /v1/generate -> eu-north standby pool, sticky: false
Devon: KV cache warmup in standby will take ~90s. Monitoring cache hit and p99.
Katie: Notifying support to prepare customer comms if SLA hit persists. @support-team please stand by.
Mike: pd note: created temporary incident status page entry, adding ETA for mitigation 10m. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/PD12345
Alyssa: Oncall handoff in 20m to Samir. If we still have >1s p99 at handoff, escalate to SRE lead.
Samir: I'll take the handoff. Keep me looped on any A/B tests hitting the route.
Devon: Observability: p99 dropped from 1.45s -> 0.88s after route switch + batch reduction. KV hit recovering to 65%.
Katie: Great. Support: we observed customer retries but no data loss. Label affected customers for later postmortem.
Alyssa: For postmortem: include autoscaler quota limit, KV cache sizing, routing fallback latency delta, and communications timeline.
Mike: Closing immediate mitigation -> marking incident as mitigated, but PD remains open for follow-up. I'll de-duplicate alerts and silence related monitors for 30m.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — Mitigation applied. p99 below threshold. Monitoring for 30m.
pagerduty-bot: PD12345 acknowledged by Mike, set to status 'acknowledged'.
Alyssa: Thanks everyone. Samir, take over for next 3 hours. I'll update exec briefly in 30.
Samir: Acked handoff. Will run capacity request for eu-west quota increase and schedule cache tuning.
Katie: Postmortem owner: Alyssa + Samir. ETA for draft: 48h.
Devon: Quick note: consider soft-QoS: limit large-batch integration traffic or route to dedicated capacity automatically when queue depth spikes.
Alyssa: Agreed. We'll add to action items.
Mike: Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
